00087 VOID CHumanPlayer::OnEnterMap( CVLogicMap * pMap, CVArea * pArea )
00088 {
00089         BOOL    bSeeArea = CanRecvMsg();
00090         if( bSeeArea )
00091         {
00092                 m_pClientObj->SendMsg( GetId(), SM_SETMAP, m_wX, m_wY, 0, (LPVOID)pMap->GetName() );
00093                 DWORD   dwParam[4] = { MAKEFEATHER( 0, m_Humandesc.dbinfo.btHair, 0, 0 ), 0, 0, 0 };
00094                 m_pClientObj->SendMsg( GetId(), SM_SETPLAYER, m_wX, m_wY, 0x100, (LPVOID)dwParam, sizeof( DWORD ) * 4 );
00095                 m_pClientObj->SendMsg( GetId(), SM_SETPLAYERNAME, 0xff, 0, 0, (LPVOID)GetName() );
00096                 m_pClientObj->SendMsg( 1, 0x2c4, 0, 0, 0, NULL );       //      ÉèÖÃµØÍ¼µÄÊôÐÔ dwflag = 1 Õ½¶·£¬ dwflag = 0 ·ÇÕ½¶·
00097                 m_pClientObj->SendMsg( 0, SM_SETMAPNAME, 0, 0, 0, (LPVOID)pMap->GetTitle() );
00098                 m_pClientObj->SendMsg( 0xf2d505d7, SM_READY, 0, 0, 0, NULL );
00099                 UpdateProp();
00100                 pArea->AppearFor( this );
00101                 for( int i = 0;i < 8;i ++ )
00102                 {
00103                         if( pArea->GetAroundArea(i) != NULL )
00104                         {
00105                                 if( bSeeArea )pArea->GetAroundArea(i)->AppearFor( this );
00106                         }
00107                 }
00108         }
00109         CAliveObject::OnEnterMap( pMap, pArea );
00110 }

00200 BOOL CHumanPlayer::UnEquipItem( int pos, DWORD dwMakeIndex )
00201 {
00202         if( dwMakeIndex == 0 || m_Equipments[pos].dwMakeIndex != dwMakeIndex )
00203                 return FALSE;
00204         ITEM    item;
00205         if( !m_ItemBox.AddItem(m_Equipments[pos]))
00206                 return FALSE;
00207         if( !m_Equipments.UnEquipItem(pos, item ))
00208         {
00209                 m_ItemBox.RemoveItem(dwMakeIndex);
00210                 return FALSE;
00211         }
00212         if( m_pClientObj != NULL )
00213                 m_pClientObj->SendAddItem( item );
00214 
00215         return TRUE;
00216 }
